meta.quality_policy: Four-option bilingual MCQs grounded only in the supplied 2025 textbook. Activities and non-examinable prompts are excluded. Attributed or qualified claims in the textbook are preserved as such. Dates, rulers, inscriptions, places, administrative offices, taxes, courts, edicts, economic institutions and trade networks are reinforced through direct recall, association and statement-analysis formats.
meta.page_reference_note: page_en refers to the printed English textbook page; Tamil printed page numbers differ and are not inferred.

questions.q_en:
